title: orch services record v1 (.orch/addons/services/services/<id>.json)
description: One background service the Services add-on keeps running with the computer's own service tool (launchd on macOS, systemd user units on Linux, a Task Scheduler task on Windows). One plain JSON file per service, written atomically (new file + rename). Fields this version does not know are kept when the file is rewritten. See addons/services/README.md.

id.description: Slug, also the file name. Names the platform entry (ch.orch.svc.<workspace id>.<id> / orch-svc-<workspace id>-<id>.service).

command.description: Program and its arguments as typed (argv). The platform entry holds the program's full path, found when the service was added.

cwd.description: Working folder relative to the workspace root; stays inside it.

auto.description: Starts by itself after this computer restarts (or the person logs in).

adopted.description: Only on a found service the person chose to manage with orch: the existing entry it points at. orch acts on that entry and never writes, moves or renames it; remove only forgets the record.

entry.description: The launchd label or the systemd user unit name.

path.description: The plist or unit file, absolute.

share.description: Only on a service made by `orch services share`: the shared folder and the random mark its server puts in the X-Orch-Share header of every answer, so the link check can tell it from any other server. Not a secret.

dir.description: The shared folder, absolute and resolved.
